coa23.scope: Ground boundaries hand-digitized by City of Austin from early 2023 aerials; clipped to existing ground/building masks. Public objectId retained. No elevation claim.

surface-default.scope: Survey establishes impervious class, not material: parking asphalt; sidewalks and driveways concrete; patios/courtyards/pavement generic paving. Exact material and age remain unverified.

aerial25.scope: Viewed ground/planting extent. No imagery pixels shipped. Tiled service title says 2025 Aerials while its description retains 2021; explicit 2025 mosaic used.

canopy-ground.scope: Planted ground under tree cover; turf versus mulch and occluded edge inferred. Paths and buildings cut out; no individual plants or heights asserted.

landscape-extent.scope: Zones traced around visible planted/tree clusters. Exact edges under canopy inferred; clipped against mapped hardscape and buildings. Not a survey of each planting bed.

material-extent.scope: Photo material applied to a bounded public forecourt outline; map sidewalk attributes buffered to recorded width or a 2.4m fallback. Extent is approximate, not photographic proof of every covered point.

panel-form.scope: Reusable concrete panel/paver joints and within-material variation are visual reconstruction, not a survey of individual joints. Reviewed courts use the existing renderer walking-deck grade; this is continuity with modeled pavement, not measured elevation.

gdc-court.scope: Red rectangular pavers in the open GDC court; colour/pattern observed, dimensions inferred.

engineering-aprons.scope: Exposed aggregate at the reviewed ETC west entrance. The elevated Cockrell terrace is not used as evidence of ground-level paving. Joint spacing and extent approximate.

mccombs-apron.scope: Tan/brown laid pavers on the reviewed McCombs forecourt. Applied only to east-side apron outlines visible in the aerial; precise photo-to-apron correspondence remains provisional, individual joints inferred.

city-sidewalk.scope: SIDEWALK_SURFACE attribute of an EXISTING sidewalk. Width from WIDTH feet when populated, otherwise 2.4m inferred. Lateral alignment approximate; only existing hardscape is reclassified.

selection.constructionMask: 2025 visible redevelopment south of 21st excluded; no transient surface copied.

geometry.scope: Bounded application of observed material, not photo camera position.
